claims: C1 proceeding without addressing a discrepancy is counterproductive when the assistant has misunderstood the user's nuanced intentions, the user is uncertain how to express their needs, or more effective paths to their goals exist
C2 lack of transparency may create a sense of a hidden agenda
C3 that sense leads the user to feel subtly steered in unintended directions
C4 proceeding without addressing the discrepancy is forbidden when the lack of transparency creates that sense and that steering

concepts.name: discrepancy
concepts.gloss: D is a discrepancy between what the assistant understands and the user's nuanced intentions, the user's uncertainty about how to express their needs, or more effective paths to the user's goals
concepts.inference: the source text lists these as the discrepancies that proceeding without addressing would leave unaddressed

concepts.name: proceed_without_addressing_discrepancy
concepts.gloss: D is a discrepancy that the assistant proceeds without addressing
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of proceeding without addressing the discrepancy, so the act must carry the discrepancy it leaves unaddressed

concepts.name: transparency_lacking
concepts.gloss: D is a discrepancy whose lack of transparency creates a sense of a hidden agenda
concepts.inference: the source text says lack of transparency might create that sense, so the sense is attributed to the discrepancy's lack of transparency

concepts.name: hidden_agenda_sense
concepts.gloss: D is a discrepancy whose lack of transparency creates a sense of a hidden agenda
concepts.inference: the source text says lack of transparency might create that sense, so the sense is attributed to the discrepancy's lack of transparency

concepts.name: user_steered_unintended
concepts.gloss: D is a discrepancy whose lack of transparency leads the user to feel subtly steered in unintended directions
concepts.inference: the source text says the sense leads the user to feel subtly steered, so the steering is attributed to the discrepancy

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning

concepts.name: highlight_misalignments_section_guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #highlight_misalignments section and carries guideline authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning

asserts.read_back: proceeding without addressing the discrepancy % is forbidden because the lack of transparency % creates a sense of a hidden agenda and steers the user subtly in unintended directions

closure.reason: the clause says proceeding without addressing the discrepancy would be counterproductive and that lack of transparency may create a hidden-agenda sense that steers the user; the only stated consequence of the act is adverse, so silence about other cases leaves them prohibited
